Thanks for getting in touch.

Confirm the container is listening on the port declared in the service definition. A mismatch here produces a health check failure that looks like a timeout. Increase the initial delay if the application needs time to warm up before it can answer. Thirty seconds is a reasonable starting point for services that load models or caches. A health check must return within the timeout using only local state. [1]

If that does not resolve it, reply to this message and a support engineer will pick it up.
